description: visible steps and its rest is Part.visible, in both directions. 'shy' is authored visible and hidden by a key, then falls back to visible when a later key stops mentioning the channel -- absent means REST, not 'hold whatever the previous key left'. 'shown' is authored hidden and revealed by a key, which is the case that fails if an implementation treats Part.visible as a gate applied after the pose rather than as the value the pose replaces. Neither ever blends: at t=0.25 and t=0.75, mid-segment, both are still fully one state or the other.
